description: This PHP source file defines the HomeViewModulelistmenu class, which extends ViewModulelistmenu and manages the display of a user's recently viewed items in the SuiteCRM application. It fetches recent view history using a Tracker bean, processes each item to generate summaries and images, and passes this data to a template for rendering.

classes.name: HomeViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A class managing the display of a module list menu, particularly recently viewed items, in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches recently viewed items for the current user, processes each item to generate summaries and images, and assigns the data to a template for rendering the module list menu.
